regripThresholdDegrees.description: Cumulative rotation, in degrees, from the tracker's last confirmed cardinal pose that fires the next regrip. Every pair of the cube's 24 legal poses is exactly 90° apart, so this must stay strictly between 0° and 90°.

artificialDriftDegreesPerSecond.description: Speed, in degrees per second, the diagnostics gauge's needle is allowed to move. Synthesized smoothing for the display only, so the needle reads as a continuous drift toward the next lock-in point rather than jumping between samples; the regrip detector itself always reacts to the raw sample immediately.
